name: Anthropic (Claude)
shortDescription: AI model provider known for strong reasoning, long context windows, and safety-focused design.
description: Provider of the Claude family of models, known for strong reasoning, long context windows, and helpfulness with a focus on safety. Excellent for analytical tasks, documentation-heavy workflows, complex tool use, and structured outputs. We choose Claude when we need high-quality reasoning, longer contexts, and nuanced instruction-following for chat, agents, and knowledge-heavy assistants.
